deskzones.title: Tidy desktop
deskzones.toggle.sub: Your Windows desktop icons sort themselves into zones.
deskzones.state.noDesktop: The Windows desktop isn't open. It will be tidied when you open it.
deskzones.state.noFit: The zones don't all fit: icons go in rows, without frames.
deskzones.layer.failed: Icons are tidy, but the frames can't be drawn ({reason}).
deskzones.reason.no-workerw: Windows won't let us draw behind the icons
deskzones.error.noDesktop: Open the Windows desktop to tidy it.
deskzones.frames.sub: A soft panel with each zone's name.
deskzones.edit.name: Name
deskzones.edit.show.sub: If you hide it, its icons go to Other.
deskzones.edit.fallback: Other is always shown: it holds anything without a zone.
deskzones.rules.sub: Send specific things to the zone you want.
deskzones.rule.name: Name with “{value}” → {zone}
deskzones.rule.kind.name: The name contains
deskzones.rule.value.name: For example: invoice
deskzones.restore.sub: Puts icons, their size and their place back as they were.
deskzones.restore.done: Done: your desktop is back as it was.
deskzones.restore.pending: It will go back as it was when you open the Windows desktop.
deskzones.safe: No file is ever moved or deleted: only where the icons show changes.
